title: Box Office Thriller: ‘Michael’ Returns to No. 1 Thanks to Imax and Other Premium Screens, ‘Obsession’ Also a Win
summary: Lionsgate's record-smashing Michael Jackson biopic and 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' — which crossed the $500 million mark globally on Friday — continue to dominate the top of the chart as Curry Barker's 'Obsession' is opening in third-place with a strong $15 million.
